description: Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas is a comforting and nutritious staple in Middle Eastern cuisine, celebrated for its vibrant flavor and wholesome ingredients. This hearty soup features tender red lentils simmered with aromatic vegetables and traditional spices, creating a truly satisfying meal. It is a perfect blend of simplicity and rich taste, ideal for warming the soul on any day.

instructions.title: Prepare Ingredients
instructions.text: Rinse the red lentils thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear; drain well. Chop the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the carrots and potato into small, uniform pieces. This ensures even cooking.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.

instructions.title: Add Vegetables and Spices
instructions.text: Stir in the diced carrots and potato. Sauté for about 5 minutes, allowing the vegetables to soften slightly. Add the ground cumin and ground turmeric, stirring constantly for 1 minute until the spices are fragrant, coating all the vegetables.

instructions.title: Combine with Lentils and Liquid
instructions.text: Add the rinsed and drained red lentils to the pot. Pour in the vegetable broth or water. Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer.

instructions.title: Simmer Until Tender
instructions.text: Allow the soup to simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils and vegetables are very tender. The lentils should break down and thicken the soup. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking to the bottom of the pot.

instructions.title: Blend and Season
instructions.text: For a smoother soup, use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup, leaving some texture, or blend half of the soup in a regular blender and return it to the pot. Stir in the fresh lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Ladle the hot Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas into bowls. Garnish generously with fresh chopped cilantro or parsley. Serve immediately with a wedge of lemon on the side for an extra burst of freshness.

tips: For an extra layer of flavor, consider adding a pinch of dried mint or sumac along with the lemon juice at the end.
If you prefer a thicker soup, reduce the amount of liquid slightly, or simmer uncovered for an additional 5-10 minutes. For a thinner soup, add more hot broth or water.
Store leftover Adas in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days. It freezes well for up to 3 months, making it great for meal prep.
article:
Discover the heartwarming embrace of Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas, a culinary jewel that transcends mere sustenance to become a symbol of comfort, tradition, and wholesome goodness. This vibrant, nutritious soup, deeply rooted in Middle Eastern cuisine, is a staple in Lebanese households, cherished for its simplicity, affordability, and incredibly satisfying flavor. Whether you're seeking a light lunch, a comforting dinner, or a healthy meal prep option, Adas is a versatile dish that promises to delight your senses and nourish your body. Join us on a journey to explore the magic behind this humble yet magnificent soup, learn how to prepare it, and unlock the secrets to making it truly unforgettable.

## What is Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas?

Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas, or "Shorbet Adas" in Arabic, is a classic Middle Eastern soup renowned for its beautiful golden-orange hue and velvety texture. Unlike some more complex stews, Adas celebrates the humble red lentil, transforming it into a rich, flavorful broth with minimal fuss. This soup is a testament to the power of simple ingredients working in harmony: red lentils, often combined with carrots, potatoes, onions, and garlic, simmered in vegetable or chicken broth, and brightened with a generous squeeze of fresh lemon juice at the end.

Its appeal lies not only in its delicious taste but also in its incredible nutritional profile. Red lentils are a powerhouse of plant-based protein, dietary fiber, iron, and various B vitamins, making Adas an excellent choice for a healthy and filling meal. It's naturally gluten-free (ensure broth is too) and easily made vegan, aligning perfectly with a variety of dietary preferences. Historically, this soup has been a go-to dish during colder months, fasting periods like Lent and Ramadan, and whenever a nourishing, easy-to-digest meal is needed. The Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas is more than just food; it’s a bowl of warmth, tradition, and home.

## Ingredients You Need

Crafting the perfect Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas requires a handful of fresh, quality ingredients. Here's what you'll need to gather:

*   **Red Lentils:** 1 cup (about 200g) – The star of the show. Make sure they are split red lentils, as they cook faster and break down more easily, giving the soup its characteristic creamy texture. Rinse them thoroughly before use.
*   **Olive Oil:** 2-3 tablespoons – For sautéing the aromatics and adding a rich, fruity base.
*   **Onion:** 1 large, chopped – Provides a foundational sweetness and depth of flavor.
*   **Garlic:** 3-4 cloves, minced – Essential for that aromatic punch.
*   **Carrot:** 1 medium, chopped – Adds natural sweetness, color, and nutrients.
*   **Potato:** 1 medium, peeled and diced – Contributes to the soup's body and creamy texture. (Optional, but highly recommended for richness).
*   **Vegetable Broth (or Chicken Broth):** 6-8 cups (1.5-2 liters) – The liquid base. Use a good quality broth for the best flavor.
*   **Cumin:** 1 teaspoon – The signature spice for lentil soups, adding warmth and earthy notes.
*   **Turmeric:** 1/2 teaspoon – For a beautiful golden color and subtle earthy flavor, plus its health benefits.
*   **Salt & Black Pepper:** To taste – Essential for seasoning.
*   **Fresh Lemon Juice:** From 1-2 lemons – A crucial finishing touch that brightens all the flavors and adds a tangy zest.
*   **Fresh Parsley or Cilantro (optional):** For garnish and a burst of freshness.

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Follow these simple steps to create a delicious pot of Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas:

1.  **Prepare the Lentils:** Rinse the red lentils under cold running water until the water runs clear. Set aside.
2.  **Sauté the Aromatics:** In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
3.  **Add Vegetables and Spices:** Stir in the chopped carrot and potato (if using). Cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cumin and turmeric, stirring well to coat the vegetables and toast the spices for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
4.  **Combine with Lentils and Broth:** Add the rinsed red lentils to the pot, stirring to combine with the vegetables and spices. Pour in the vegetable or chicken broth. Bring the mixture to a boil.
5.  **Simmer:** Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the pot partially, and let the soup simmer for 25-35 minutes, or until the lentils and vegetables are very tender and the lentils have broken down. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
6.  **Blend (Optional):** For a smoother, creamier soup, use an immersion blender to blend a portion or all of the soup directly in the pot until it reaches your desired consistency. Alternatively, carefully transfer portions to a regular blender (vent the lid to allow steam to escape) and blend until smooth, then return to the pot.
7.  **Season and Finish:** Season the soup generously with salt and black pepper to taste. Stir in the fresh lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed – you might want more lemon, salt, or even a pinch more cumin.
8.  **Serve:** Ladle the hot soup into bowls. Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, a drizzle of olive oil, and an extra lemon wedge on the side for those who prefer more tang.

## Pro Tips for the Best Results

To elevate your Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas from good to absolutely fantastic, consider these expert tips:

*   **Rinse Lentils Thoroughly:** This is crucial to remove any dust or debris and helps prevent the soup from becoming cloudy or foamy.
*   **Don't Skimp on Lemon:** Fresh lemon juice is a game-changer for this soup. It cuts through the richness of the lentils and vegetables, adding a vital brightness and zest. Always add it at the very end to preserve its fresh flavor.
*   **Bloom Your Spices:** Briefly toasting the cumin and turmeric with the aromatics before adding the liquid enhances their flavor and aroma significantly.
*   **Adjust Consistency:** If your soup is too thick, add a little more broth or hot water until it reaches your desired consistency. If it's too thin, let it simmer uncovered for a bit longer to reduce.
*   **Salt in Layers:** Season with salt throughout the cooking process, tasting as you go. Add a little when sautéing the vegetables, and then adjust at the end. Remember that broth can be salty, so start cautiously.
*   **High-Quality Broth:** The flavor of your broth greatly impacts the final taste of the soup. Opt for a good quality vegetable or chicken broth. If using water, consider adding a bouillon cube for extra depth.

## Serving Suggestions

Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas is wonderfully satisfying on its own, but it truly shines when served with a few complementary accompaniments.

*   **Fresh Pita Bread:** Warm pita bread, either plain or toasted, is perfect for scooping up the soup.
*   **Crispy Pita Croutons:** Fry or bake small pieces of pita bread until golden and crispy for a delightful textural contrast.
*   **Extra Lemon Wedges:** Always offer extra lemon wedges on the side, allowing each diner to customize the tanginess to their liking.
*   **Fresh Herbs:** A sprinkle of fresh chopped parsley, cilantro, or mint adds vibrant color and a burst of fresh flavor.
*   **Drizzle of Olive Oil:** A final swirl of good quality extra virgin olive oil enhances the soup's richness and aroma.
*   **Side Salad:** A simple green salad or a traditional Fattoush salad makes a refreshing counterpoint to the hearty soup.
*   **Pickles:** Middle Eastern pickles (mekhalal) or pickled turnips offer a delightful sour crunch that complements the soup beautifully.

## Variations and Substitutions

While the classic Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas recipe is perfect as is, it's also incredibly versatile and open to creative variations:

*   **Add Greens:** Stir in a handful of fresh spinach or Swiss chard during the last 5-10 minutes of cooking for added nutrients and color.
*   **Spice It Up:** For a bit of heat, add a pinch of red pepper flakes with the other spices, or swirl in some harissa paste at the end.
*   **Tomato Paste:** A tablespoon of tomato paste can be added with the aromatics to give the soup a deeper color and a subtle umami note.
*   **Different Vegetables:** Feel free to experiment with other root vegetables like sweet potato or parsnip for a different flavor profile.
*   **Vegan Option:** This soup is naturally vegan if you use vegetable broth and ensure no animal products in your olive oil (which is standard).
*   **Garnish Creativity:** Beyond parsley, consider fresh mint, a sprinkle of Aleppo pepper, or even a dollop of plain yogurt (for non-vegan versions) for a creamy tang.
*   **Make it Meatier:** While traditionally vegetarian, you could add shredded cooked chicken or small pieces of lamb during the last stage of simmering for a heartier meal.

Lebanese Red Lentil Soup Adas is more than just a recipe; it's an invitation to experience the warmth and generosity of Middle Eastern cuisine. Its wholesome ingredients, comforting flavors, and ease of preparation make it an indispensable dish for any home cook. So, gather your ingredients, follow these steps, and prepare to savor a bowl of pure, unadulterated comfort.
